component.name: FetchPlaylistTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "fetchPlaylist" end sub
sub fetchPlaylist() m.top.state = "loading" url = m.top.url if url = "" or url = invalid m.top.error = "No playlist URL provided" m.top.state = "error" return end if
result = HttpGet(url, "", 0) ' No caching for playlists — always fresh if not result.ok m.top.error = "Failed to download playlist. " + IIF(result.error <> invalid, result.error, "Check URL or network.") m.top.state = "error" return end if
channels = ParseM3U(result.body) if channels.Count() = 0 m.top.error = "No channels found. Check that the URL points to a valid M3U playlist." m.top.state = "error" return end if
m.top.channels = { items: channels, count: channels.Count() } m.top.state = "done" end sub
